instructions:
You are labelling memory items that a system extracted from a two-person conversation (LoCoMo benchmark). Each row gives `transcript_excerpt` (turns as "[speaker] text"), `item` (a one-sentence rendering of the extracted memory item) and `quote` (the text the system cited as its evidence). Label two columns per row.

`gold_quote_supports_item`: `supports` if the quote, read in the excerpt, states or directly implies the item; otherwise `does_not_support`. A quote that does not appear in the transcript excerpt is `does_not_support`. Judge the item as a whole, including its polarity and category; numeric strength, proficiency and weight values are not part of the judgement.

`gold_source_type`: how the item's knowledge reaches the memory: `user_stated` (a speaker says it about themselves in the conversation), `tool_result` (it comes from a tool output; there are no tools in this data, so this should be rare or absent), `inferred` (the item is a conclusion drawn from what was said rather than something said outright), `imported` (it comes from an external record brought into the conversation). Leave it null when no option fits.

Do not edit the excerpt, item or quote. Judge only from the row.
